title: Azan Smart Screen
summary: A connected smart screen designed for Azan, Qibla, Zikr, Dua, and daily intelligent interaction.
content: Azan Smart Screen is ALi365's smart display product for meaningful daily interaction. It combines a refined hardware form with an independently developed system experience.   The product is designed around Azan, Qibla, Zikr, Dua, and daily information interactions. Its AIOT-ready smart screen design supports connected environments, while its AOSP-based system foundation gives ALi365 stronger control over product behavior, usability, and long-term experience quality.   Azan Smart Screen is suitable for homes, community spaces, prayer rooms, and connected smart living scenarios that need a focused, reliable smart display experience.

title: Tasbih Band
summary: A wearable smart counting product concept built around Muslim daily prayer use.
content: Tasbih Band reflects ALi365's focus on culturally aware smart devices. It brings wearable convenience to smart counting support for daily prayer routines.   The product direction centers on lightweight interaction, connected device potential, and practical product thinking for real daily-life needs. It shows how smart hardware can support focused personal routines without making the experience complicated.   Tasbih Band is designed for users who want a focused, convenient, and modern wearable experience for prayer-related counting and personal routines.

title: PassBox Pro
summary: A secure productivity app for password vaults, encrypted memos, categories, and offline account organization.
content: PassBox Pro is a practical software product for organizing sensitive information and productivity records in a focused mobile experience.   The product supports password vaults for secure account organization, encrypted memos for notes and ideas, category-based data management, and an offline-first product direction for reliable access. It is designed to keep private information organized without adding unnecessary complexity.   PassBox Pro is suitable for users and teams that need a simple, modern way to manage private information, credentials, notes, and structured personal data.

title: AI Website Systems

content: AI Website Systems represent ALi365's software direction for AI-powered web creation, content generation, and digital operation tools.   The product direction supports AI-assisted website generation workflows, content generation for business pages and updates, and operational tools for faster digital delivery. Its software architecture is designed for practical business use, helping teams move from idea to published content more efficiently.   AI Website Systems are suitable for businesses that need efficient website creation, content operations, and AI-assisted digital workflows.

content: ALi365 develops modern software applications that support everyday productivity, information management, and practical business workflows.
